fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as on PAN card. NPS is a voluntary retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA. You can invest and get market-linked returns for retirement corpus.
fields.instruction_hi: PAN card ke anusar poora naam likhein. NPS ek swaichchhik retirement bachat yojana hai jo PFRDA dvara niyamit hai. Aap retirement corpus ke liye invest karke market-linked returns pa sakte hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY. NPS is open to Indian citizens aged 18-70 years. You must contribute until age 60, after which you get pension.
fields.instruction_hi: DD/MM/YYYY mein janm tithi likhein. NPS 18-70 saal ke Indian nagrikon ke liye open hai. 60 saal tak yogdan karna hoga, uske baad pension milegi.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your 10-character PAN number. PAN is mandatory for NPS as contributions are tax-deductible under Section 80CCD(1) up to Rs 1.5 lakh and additional Rs 50,000 under 80CCD(1B).
fields.instruction_hi: Apna 10 akshar PAN number likhein. NPS ke liye PAN zaruri hai kyunki yogdan Section 80CCD(1) ke tahat 1.5 lakh aur 80CCD(1B) ke tahat additional 50,000 rupaye tak kar-katautiयोग्य hain.

fields.instruction_en: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar number for KYC. Aadhaar-based eKYC is the fastest way to open NPS account online without visiting any office.
fields.instruction_hi: KYC ke liye 12 ank ka Aadhaar number likhein. Aadhaar-based eKYC se kisi bhi karyalay mein jaaye bina online NPS account sabse tezi se khula jaata hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your bank account number for contribution auto-debit and future pension credit.
fields.instruction_hi: Yogdan auto-debit aur bhavishy mein pension credit ke liye apna bank khata number likhein.

fields.instruction_en: Select Active or Auto choice. Active: you decide asset allocation between Equity (E), Corporate Bonds (C), and Government Securities (G). Auto: allocation is automatic based on age.
fields.instruction_hi: Active ya Auto choice chunein. Active: aap Equity (E), Corporate Bonds (C) aur Government Securities (G) ke beech allocation khud decide karte hain. Auto: aayu ke hisaab se automatic allocation hoti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter nominee's full name. In case of subscriber's death, the nominee receives the entire NPS corpus. You can add up to 3 nominees with percentage allocation.
fields.instruction_hi: Nominee ka poora naam likhein. Subscriber ki mrityu par nominee ko poora NPS corpus milega. Aap percentage allocation ke saath 3 nominees tak jod sakte hain.
